title: A Change of Platform
story: Leila arrived at the station with ten minutes to spare. A screen said her train would leave from platform four, not platform two. She walked through the tunnel and found the right stairs. Her carriage was near the front. She showed her ticket, sat by the window, and sent a message to her uncle. The train left on time, and she watched the fields go by.
